text:
morgan: Heads-up — our sampleapp is reading both REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_API_KEY, which is confusing new devs. They hit 401s after rotating keys and aren't sure which env var to update.

alex: Yep, saw that. SDK currently prefers REDWOOD_API_KEY (legacy) if present, then falls back to RW_API_KEY. That breaks workflows where teams expect project-scoped keys to take precedence.

sasha: That priority is historical. For Dedicated/Private we expect project-level keys (RW_PROJECT_API_KEY) to be authoritative. We should formalize a precedence and document it.

morgan: @alex @sasha can we decide a canonical order? Also sampleapp and quickstart docs need to match to avoid onboarding friction.

alex: Proposal for precedence (highest -> lowest): 1) per-route ephemeral token env (RW_EPHEMERAL_TOKEN), 2) RW_PROJECT_API_KEY, 3) REDWOOD_API_KEY, 4) RW_API_KEY. Emit a deprecation warning when RW_API_KEY is used.

sasha: Agreed on the order. Another issue: rotation on long-lived streams — SDK caches token and doesn't refresh on 401 gracefully. Repro steps: start stream, rotate key in console, stream continues and then 401s after next keepalive and never recovers until process restart.

morgan: Oof. We need: token refresh hook + retry-on-auth-failure path for streams. Minimal fix first: detect 401 -> try refresh provider -> reconnect once.

alex: I'll open an SDK PR with precedence + deprecation warning + unit tests. For the streaming quickfix I can add a reconnect-on-401 with exponential backoff.

sasha: I'll update sampleapp to set RW_PROJECT_API_KEY explicitly and add an e2e that simulates key rotation. Adding a short note in the quickstart about which env var to set.

samir: Also seeing mismatch in local dev: docker-compose sets RW_API_KEY in container, but devs set REDWOOD_API_KEY locally. When they docker exec the container they forget to sync and auth fails. Suggest adding a dev-lint that flags both being set with different values.

deploy-bot: deploy:canary to staging failed — 401 on model-ingest service during rollout (task id t-8472). Rolling back.

morgan: OK action items: 1) SDK patch for canonical precedence + deprecate RW_API_KEY, 2) sampleapp/quickstart align to RW_PROJECT_API_KEY, 3) add stream rotation/retry tests, 4) dev-linter rule for conflicting envs, 5) docs update. Volunteers?

alex: I'll do the SDK patch and tests. Plan to target a patch release tomorrow.

sasha: I'll update sampleapp + add e2e for rotation. Will include repro script in tests.

samir: I'll add the linter rule and a CI check that warns on conflicting env var usage in docker-compose files.

morgan: :thumbsup: please link PRs here and let's add a one-line changelog. We should also send a short note to #onboarding once docs are updated so support stops triaging this.

alex: Created draft PR #4921 with precedence change + deprecation warning. Putting streaming reconnect in a follow-up.

sasha: Added test scaffold in sampleapp branch and a repro script at scripts/rotate-key.sh. Will link when ready.
